upload: ./hello.txt to .../hello.txt
caption: Bucket names are globally unique — across every AWS account on Earth.

code:
$ aws s3 ls s3://ltv-academy-demo-2026/
2026-09-19 10:14:02   20 hello.txt

$ aws s3 rm s3://ltv-academy-demo-2026/hello.txt
$ aws s3 rb s3://ltv-academy-demo-2026
caption: rb only works on an empty bucket — a deliberate safety guard.
